name: No-show cancellation fee is valid
statement: The fee stands when all of Ryde's conditions are established: the driver canceled with reason rider_no_show; the arrival indication is valid (CW-R06); the driver stayed at the pick-up point during the wait (CW-F04); and the wait meets the threshold (CW-F03). How FairRyde handles sparse GPS, missing records and rider counter-evidence is set out row by row in decision table DT-CW-NOSHOW, with each row's own credibility. Organizer profile: the case's policy object (DISP-002: S$5.00, no-show cancellation at 8 minutes). Ryde profile: S$6.61 after more than 3 minutes.

sources.quote: Rider will be charged a Cancellation Fee of $6.61* if:
The driver presses "I'm Here", waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to arrive at the pick-up point and cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)
